description.narrative: Projektets mål är att förstärka lokala samhällen genom att inrätta småskaliga by-företag som kommer att producera möbler och hönsfoder från palmer och dess avfall. EGYCOM syftar till att kapitalisera på framgången av pilotprojektet som ägde rum i Al Quayat by i Al-Minya. Avtalspart är Egyptian Society for Endogenous Development of Local Communities, org.nr 5450, Cairo, 2003. Egypt.

The objective of the project is to empower local communities by setting up small-scale village enterprises that will produce furniture items, carina and poultry feed from palm midribs and palm tree residues. It aims to capitalise on the success of the pilot project that took place in the Al Quayat village in Minya governorate. Agreement partner is Egyptian Society for Endogenous Development of Local Communities, org reg no 5450, Cairo, 2003. Egypt.

The project gave an important chance for EGYCOM to fulfil its societal objectives via the innovation of appropriate village business models for the poor after establishing furniture factory for palm midribs furniture and a workshop for palm leaflets handwoven products. EGYCOM decided -after interacting with the villagers and studying the feasibility of the project components- to change the Poultry feed and Crina project into Palm leaflets project which enabled the project to benefit more women in the village with an easily up scaled work that can easily spread in different villages.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
